title: Triangulo
description: triangulo.com.br Triângulo Tecnologia E Comércio Ltda. is a Brazilian IT company founded in 1983 in Presidente Dutra, São Paulo, making it one of the oldest technology providers in Brazil with 43 years of market presence. With approximately 100 to 200 employees and estimated revenue of 20 to 50 million reais, it serves over 500 clients across small, medium and large businesses nationwide. Its core products include proprietary ERP systems, business intelligence dashboards, process automation and IT consulting services. The company offers full-cycle implementation from customization through integration to ongoing technical support. Key sectors include manufacturing, retail, logistics, healthcare and financial services across Brazil's interior markets. Its long track record and proprietary technology platform differentiate it from newer entrants in the Brazilian enterprise software market.
